On the clear ice of a frozen lake, a small creature stirs for the first time: it has a slender body balanced on a long tail, mottled green scales, six thin jointed legs and a single huge dark eye. The camera pushes in at slow speed. It tests its limbs and creeps forward into the light. The shot ends as the creature pauses, perfectly still.

overall_soundscape: A soft wet click and the faint rustle of its first steps.
